# Three.js 0.160.0

`three.module.js` and `LICENSE` are copied unchanged from the [three 0.160.0 package](https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.160.0.tgz), from `build/three.module.js` and `LICENSE` respectively. The browser module is self-contained and is used by the WebXR AR sender and receiver examples.

Preserve the full [MIT notice](LICENSE), copyright 2010-2023 Three.js Authors, and the [ISC notice for the embedded Earcut 2.2.4 port](earcut.LICENSE), copyright 2016 Mapbox. The Earcut notice is copied from [its matching upstream tag](https://github.com/mapbox/earcut/blob/v2.2.4/LICENSE). This version is separate from the older Three.js used by Jeeliz filters.

Source: [Three.js r160](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r160).
